issues: The summary says the standard is 'the latest of the IEEE 7000 series' as a flat fact. That was Doc Searls's description on 29 January 2026, and it is now out of date: IEEE Std 7014.1-2026 (Recommended Practice for Ethical Considerations of Emulated Empathy in Partner-Based ...) was published on IEEE Xplore on 12 June 2026, according to an IEEE Xplore search API query run 2026-09-23.

The claim that it is free 'through the IEEE GET Program for AI Ethics and Governance Standards' rests only on Searls, who chaired the working group; IEEE's GET program listing could not be fetched (it is a client-side app). The IEEE Xplore search API marks document 11360682 as accessType 'promotional', 'Freely Available from IEEE', which confirms free access but not the GET label. The claim is now attributed to Searls.

fieldFixes.summary: IEEE published 7012-2025, IEEE Standard for Machine Readable Personal Privacy Terms, on 20 January 2026 as IEEE Xplore document 11360682 (DOI 10.1109/IEEESTD.2025.11360682). It is free to read; Doc Searls, who chaired the working group, wrote at launch that it is part of the IEEE GET Program for AI Ethics and Governance Standards and the latest of the IEEE 7000 series. Its abstract names 'websites, applications and AI agents' among the service providers covered.
